geo_source: OSM swimming-pool polygons on the Eagle / Manchebo / Druif low-rise strip
ref_sources: The game already draws the swimming-pool water and coping from the mapped outlines. This hero adds the stone deck, white loungers and a thatch cabana around Amsterdam Manor, La Cabana, Costa Linda, Bucuti & Tara, Manchebo, Divi Aruba, Tamarijn and Druif (Divi Dutch Village), plus a few sand chairs seaward of those resorts. Existing resort, palapa and fofoti heroes are not modified.
